findings.reason: the done-when's convergence precondition is the clause that stops a miss being read as a representation defect, and as written it can pass without any refinement happening, so the plan must name `ironBoundary/knotSet` and `ironBoundary/observationPoints` instead.
findings.text: s10 says imas-efit's "boundary resolution (knot and observation-point counts, `internalResolution`) is refined until S changes by under 0.5 %", but `internalResolution` is a `<ironModel>` attribute of type `SingleValue<double>` (src/efitIronModel.h:33) that appears nowhere in `configuration/` and is required only when `internalIronCurrents` are configured (src/efitIronModel.cpp:110-113), while the knob is consumed only by `InternalIronCurrents::computeResponses(resolution, ...)` (src/internalIronCurrents.cpp:313) — the knot and observation-point counts are instead attributes of `ironBoundary/knotSet` (`knotCount`, `basisFunctionCount`, `normalizedDistance`, `mu`, `tknot`) and `ironBoundary/observationPoints` (src/ironBoundary.cpp:150-190, enforced by checkData at 195-199) — so a worker following the sentence refines a scalar that changes nothing for a boundary-only configuration, S never moves, and the "under 0.5 % under one further refinement" precondition is satisfied vacuously on the first attempt, declaring the control converged while its discretisation is untouched.

findings.reason: a cross-code deliverable ran against an unspecified configuration and an unspecified quantity cannot be judged reproducing or missing anything, so the node's receipt would record a number no reviewer can score.
findings.text: clause (3) requires "the iron contribution at the WEST in-vessel probes and flux loops is tabulated beside §6's", but the section's mechanism configures imas-efit with the iron_core IDS withheld and a constant permeability (plan.html:375-378) precisely so the linear exact S is the right reference, and at WEST the iron saturates (nova's prototype reports μr 216-1667), so that tabulation needs a second imas-efit run with the IDS present and a B-H table — which the mechanism never authorises and for which it specifies no configuration — and the clause names no permeability for the constant-μ variant and no comparison target ("beside §6's" leaves open whether the scored quantity is the field, the difference from air-core, or the share of air-core).

findings.reason: a node that can only half-satisfy its done-when is reported blocked or promoted on a partial measure, and the WEST tabulation is the half that carries the §1 disagreement the whole control exists to interpret.
findings.text: s10's done-when joins two independent deliverable under one verdict: the closed-shell control at μr = 1000 and a/b = 0.9 with its μr = 1 wiring control (clauses 1-2), and a WEST probe/flux-loop tabulation (clause 3) that needs a different imas-efit configuration and measures a different quantity on a different body, so a receipt that reproduces S on the shell but cannot run the WEST configuration has no status the done-when can express, and the section that the earlier split created to carry one deliverable still carries two.

findings.reason: naming src/ironBoundary.cpp is the difference between a worker deriving the element from the source that parses it and a worker discovering the required attribute set one thrown BadInputData at a time inside a 3.0 h section.
findings.text: s10 proposes to author "a new `ironBoundaries` element" and cites only the two readers of the IDS/XML choice (src/ironCoreBuilder.cpp, src/tokamakData.cpp), but no `<ironBoundary>` or `<ironBoundaries>` element exists anywhere under imas-efit's `configuration/` to copy, and the reader that defines what such an element must contain — src/ironBoundary.cpp, whose checkData throws unless `geometry/category`, `knotSet/normalizedDistance|mu|tknot`, `observationPoints/normalizedDistance|angle` and the rest are all present — is not cited, so the node is asked to author roughly twenty required attributes of a schema it is given no pointer to.
